title: From laggard to leader: Malawi’s life expectancy transformation in Sub-Saharan African context, 1950–2023
title_zh: 从落后者到领跑者：撒哈拉以南非洲背景下马拉维预期寿命的转变，1950—2023年
title_primary: 从落后者到领跑者：撒哈拉以南非洲背景下马拉维预期寿命的转变，1950—2023年
title_secondary: From laggard to leader: Malawi’s life expectancy transformation in Sub-Saharan African context, 1950–2023
authors: Ben Malinga John (Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research, Rostock, Germany), Souza Emmanuel, Jiaxin Shi (Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research, Rostock, Germany)
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: -Life expectancy has risen substantially across Sub-Saharan African (SSA), but national trajectories have diverged. Malawi represents a striking case of transformation, moving from one of the region’s lowest ranked countries in 1950 to among its leaders in 2023 despite persistent economic stagnation. We examine how age specific mortality changes contributed to Malawi’s exceptional gains in life expectancy and compares its mortality transition with those of other SSA countries. We use age and sex specific mortality data from the 2024 United Nations World Population Prospects for 15 SSA countries between 1950 and 2023. Countries were selected to represent the highest, average, and lowest performing groups in life expectancy at birth in 1950. We analyze trends, decompose changes using the Arriaga method, and estimate potential future gains from eliminating mortality at specific ages. Results show that Malawi recorded the largest increase in life expectancy, gaining 36.2 years for females and 33.2 years for males. Its mortality decline followed a broadly similar age pattern to the region but with exceptional intensity: between 1950 and 1980, two thirds of gains came from childhood mortality reductions, while after 2000, adult survival improvements contributed nearly half. Malawi’s resilience during the HIV/AIDS crisis and rapid post 2000 recovery highlight the combined influence of expanded female education, large scale donor investment, and community-based health programs. Our findings provide the first long term age specific decomposition of Malawi’s life expectancy transformation in comparative SSA context, highlighting the changing age structure of mortality reduction in the region.
abstract_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区的预期寿命显著提升，但各国轨迹呈现分化。马拉维是一个引人注目的转型案例，尽管经济持续停滞，该国却从1950年该地区排名最低的国家之一，跃升至2023年的领先者之列。我们考察了年龄别死亡率变化如何促进马拉维预期寿命的非凡增长，并将其死亡率转型与其他撒哈拉以南非洲国家进行比较。我们使用2024年联合国《世界人口展望》中1950年至2023年间15个撒哈拉以南非洲国家的年龄和性别别死亡率数据。所选国家代表1950年出生时预期寿命的最高、平均和最低表现群体。我们分析趋势，运用Arriaga方法分解变化，并估算消除特定年龄死亡率的潜在未来收益。结果显示，马拉维的预期寿命增幅最大，女性增加36.2岁，男性增加33.2岁。其死亡率下降遵循与该地区大致相似的年龄模式，但强度异常突出：1950年至1980年间，三分之二的收益来自儿童死亡率下降，而2000年后，成人存活率改善贡献了近一半。马拉维在HIV/AIDS危机期间的韧性及2000年后的快速复苏，凸显了女性教育扩展、大规模捐助者投资和社区健康计划的综合影响。我们的研究首次在撒哈拉以南非洲比较背景下，对马拉维预期寿命转型进行了长期年龄别分解，揭示了该地区死亡率下降年龄结构的动态变化。

title: Property Taxes and Housing Allocation Under Financial Constraints
title_zh: 财政约束下的房产税与住房配置
title_primary: 财政约束下的房产税与住房配置
title_secondary: Property Taxes and Housing Allocation Under Financial Constraints
authors: Joshua Coven, Sebastian Golder, Arpit Gupta, Abdoulaye Ndiaye
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Low property taxes amplify lock-in among elderly homeowners, limiting housing access for young families. Raising them reallocates housing toward the young through two channels: capitalization into lower prices reduces required downpayments for financially constrained buyers, a form of embedded leverage, while higher tax obligations raise holding costs for older owners. In our overlapping generations model, raising California’s property taxes to Texas levels increases young homeownership while decreasing elderly homeownership. Removing step-up basis also lowers elderly homeownership, suggesting their tenure is sustained by bequest tax advantages. The tax treatment of housing shapes housing allocation across generations.
abstract_zh: 低房产税加剧了老年房主的锁定效应，限制了年轻家庭的住房获取。提高房产税通过两条渠道将住房重新分配给年轻人：资本化导致房价下降，从而降低了受财务约束购房者的首付要求，这是一种嵌入式杠杆形式；同时，更高的税负增加了老年房主的持有成本。在我们的世代交叠模型中，将加利福尼亚州的房产税提高至得克萨斯州水平，会增加年轻群体的住房拥有率，同时降低老年群体的住房拥有率。取消递增基税基也会降低老年住房拥有率，表明其居住期限由遗产税优惠所维持。住房的税收处理方式塑造了跨代际的住房分配格局。

title: Testing coefficient stability in spatial regression
title_zh: 检验空间回归中的系数稳定性
title_primary: 检验空间回归中的系数稳定性
title_secondary: Testing coefficient stability in spatial regression
authors: Ulrich K. Müller, Mark W. Watson
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper develops a test for coefficient variability in spatial regressions. The test is designed to have good power for a wide range of persistent patterns of coefficient variation, be applicable in a wide range of spatial designs, and accommodate spatial correlation in regressors and regression errors. The test approximates the locally best invariant test for coefficient stability in a Gaussian regression model with martingale-like coefficient variation under the alternative, and is thus a spatial generalization of the Nyblom (1989) test of coefficient stability in time series regressions.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一种针对空间回归中系数变异性的检验方法。该检验旨在对广泛的持续性系数变化模式具有良好的检验功效，适用于多种空间设计，并能容纳回归因子及回归误差中的空间相关性。此检验近似于高斯回归模型中系数稳定性检验的局部最优不变检验，其中备择假设下系数变化具有类鞅性质，因此它是Nyblom（1989）时间序列回归系数稳定性检验的空间推广。

title: 新供给创造新需求：市场准入负面清单的消费提振效应研究
title_zh: 新供给创造新需求：市场准入负面清单的消费提振效应研究
title_primary: 新供给创造新需求：市场准入负面清单的消费提振效应研究
authors: 谢贞发, 郭晨阳, 罗芳勇
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: 充分释放超大规模市场潜力,是推动经济高质量发展的重要议题。本文采用多时点双重差分模型,系统考察市场准入负面清单制度对居民消费的提振效应。研究发现：第一,该制度对居民家庭消费水平具有显著的提升作用。第二,在供给结构优化路径上,从企业层面看,政策实施后市场竞争加剧,同时企业创新投入有所增加;从行业层面看,企业进入主要集中在服务业,尤其是直接面向居民日常消费的生活性服务业;从家庭层面看,居民消费意愿增强,家庭储蓄率下降。在收入提振路径上,政策带动企业生产扩张和用工需求增加,居民工资性收入提升,消费能力随之增强。第三,异质性分析发现,市场准入负面清单制度的消费提振效应在制度环境较差、服务业发展滞后的地区更为显著。第四,政府干预规模过大会削弱政策效果,而增加一般公共服务支出能有效强化政策效果。本文为深化市场准入负面清单制度改革以促进消费扩容升级、强化供需双侧协同以及优化政府治理和财政支出结构提供了一定的经验参考。

title: Bank Regulation and the Rise of Nonbank Intermediation
title_zh: 银行监管与非银行中介的兴起
title_primary: 银行监管与非银行中介的兴起
title_secondary: Bank Regulation and the Rise of Nonbank Intermediation
authors: Celso Brunetti, Christoph Frei
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the rise of nonbank financial intermediation and its implications for systemic risk. We develop a structural network model of banks and nonbank financial institutions (NBFIs) that decomposes intermediation into a capacity channel, driven by bank balance-sheet constraints, and a reliance channel, reflecting NBFI funding reliance. Using U.S. banking confidential supervisory data, we estimate key structural parameters and quantify both channels. We find that fluctuations in bank-NBFI intermediation are primarily explained by the reliance channel, with variation in NBFI fragility emerging as the dominant driver. We show that NBFI intermediation can amplify shocks through funding interconnectedness.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了非银行金融中介的兴起及其对系统性风险的影响。我们构建了一个包含银行和非银行金融机构（NBFIs）的结构性网络模型，将中介活动分解为容量渠道（由银行资产负债表约束驱动）和依赖渠道（反映NBFI融资依赖）。利用美国银行保密监管数据，我们估计了关键结构性参数，并量化了这两个渠道。我们发现，银行-NBFI中介活动的波动主要由依赖渠道解释，其中NBFI脆弱性的变化成为主导驱动因素。我们表明，NBFI中介通过融资互联性可能放大冲击。

title: The Factor Bias of External Inputs: Implications for Substitution between Capital and Labor
title_zh: 外部投入的要素偏向：对资本与劳动替代关系的启示
title_primary: 外部投入的要素偏向：对资本与劳动替代关系的启示
title_secondary: The Factor Bias of External Inputs: Implications for Substitution between Capital and Labor
authors: Dimitrije Ruzic
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper reevaluates the longstanding debate on capital-labor substitution by examining the role of external inputs: raw materials, intermediate goods and services, imports, offshoring. Both a meta-analysis (analyzing existing estimates of substitution) and direct estimation (using U.S. data for 1963-2016) indicate that external inputs disproportionately displace labor. These findings imply (1) that the capital-labor ratio responds 40-80% more strongly to the price of labor than to the price of capital, (2) that value added cannot be modeled separably from gross output, and (3) that historical disagreements regarding substitution can be recast as an omitted variable bias involving external inputs.
abstract_zh: 本文通过考察外部投入（原材料、中间品与服务、进口、离岸外包）的作用，重新审视了关于资本-劳动替代的长期争论。元分析（对现有替代弹性估计值的系统性分析）与直接估计（基于1963-2016年美国数据）均表明，外部投入对劳动的替代效应尤为显著。这些发现意味着：（1）资本-劳动比对劳动价格的反应强度比对资本价格的反应强度高出40-80%；（2）增加值无法与总产出进行可分离建模；（3）历史上关于替代弹性的分歧可被重新解释为涉及外部投入的遗漏变量偏误。

title: Crowd-Sourced Chinese Genealogies as Data for Demographic and Economic History
title_zh: 众包中国家谱作为人口与经济史研究的数据
title_primary: 众包中国家谱作为人口与经济史研究的数据
title_secondary: Crowd-Sourced Chinese Genealogies as Data for Demographic and Economic History
authors: Xue, Melanie Meng
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper evaluates the usefulness of crowd-sourced Chinese genealogical data for quantitative research in demography and economic history. I first examine whether genealogies - despite well-known selection biases - produce demographic patterns consistent with established historical knowledge of China. Comparisons with existing studies show that aggregate population-growth trends and sex ratios over time align reasonably well with established demographic and historical findings, suggesting that genealogies, though selective, capture coherent and interpretable patterns. Building on these plausibility checks, the paper argues that the main value of genealogical data lies in their scalability and temporal depth, particularly as crowd-sourced digitization vastly expands the number of available records. These features make genealogies well suited to analyses that leverage variation across regions and over time, an approach that is central in modern economic history.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了众包中国族谱数据在人口学与经济史定量研究中的实用性。我首先考察族谱——尽管存在众所周知的样本选择偏差——是否能够产生与既有中国历史知识相符的人口模式。与现有研究的比较显示，总体人口增长趋势及性别比例随时间的变化与既定的人口学及历史发现相当吻合，这表明族谱虽具选择性，但捕捉到了连贯且可解释的模式。基于这些合理性检验，本文认为族谱数据的主要价值在于其可扩展性和时间深度，尤其是众包数字化极大地扩展了可用记录的数量。这些特性使族谱非常适合利用区域间及时间上的变异进行分析，而这种方法在现代经济史研究中占据核心地位。

title: A Censored Transformed Model for Proportional Outcomes with Boundary Mass and an Application to Loss Given Default Modeling
title_zh: 带边界质量的成比例结果的删失变换模型及其在违约损失率建模中的应用
title_primary: 带边界质量的成比例结果的删失变换模型及其在违约损失率建模中的应用
title_secondary: A Censored Transformed Model for Proportional Outcomes with Boundary Mass and an Application to Loss Given Default Modeling
authors: Qiang, Yuan Christopher, Sigrist, Fabio
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We introduce the zero-one censored transformed normal (ZOC-TN) model for proportional responses with potential probability mass at the boundaries 0 and 1. The model combines a censored Gaussian variable with a two-parameter affine-logit transformation on the interior (0,1). We characterize the transformation parameters, establish large-sample properties, and relate the affine-logit specification to broader classes of interior distributions. Theoretical and experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model can capture a wider range of qualitative density shapes than several benchmark models while remaining parsimonious, computationally efficient, and numerically stable. Furthermore, the ZOC-TN model can be extended (i) to account for nonlinearities and interactions in a tree-boosting machine learning framework and (ii) to explicitly model residual spatio-temporal variability. We apply the ZOC-TN model to loss given default (LGD) modeling for a large dataset of U.S. residential mortgages and compare it to multiple benchmark models. We find that a tree-boosted ZOC-TN model with a spatio-temporal frailty Gaussian process delivers the strongest out-of-sample performance, indicating that mortgage losses are shaped by nonlinear covariate effects and by unaccounted-for space-time variation.
abstract_zh: 本文提出零一截断转换正态（ZOC-TN）模型，用于处理边界0和1处可能存在概率质量的成比例响应数据。该模型将截断高斯变量与内部区间(0,1)上的双参数仿射对数比变换相结合。我们刻画了变换参数的特征，建立了大样本性质，并将仿射对数比设定与更广泛的内部分布类别联系起来。理论与实验结果表明，所提模型在保持简洁性、计算高效性和数值稳定性的同时，能够捕捉比若干基准模型更广泛的定性密度形态。此外，ZOC-TN模型可扩展至：（i）在树提升机器学习框架中纳入非线性和交互效应；（ii）显式建模残差的时空变异性。我们将ZOC-TN模型应用于美国住宅抵押贷款大样本数据的违约损失率（LGD）建模，并与多个基准模型进行比较。研究发现，结合时空脆弱性高斯过程的树提升ZOC-TN模型在样本外表现最优，表明抵押贷款损失受非线性协变量效应及未解释的时空变异共同影响。

title: Strategic Evidence Disclosure in Networks and Equilibrium Discrimination
title_zh: 网络中的策略性证据披露与均衡歧视
title_primary: 网络中的策略性证据披露与均衡歧视
title_secondary: Strategic Evidence Disclosure in Networks and Equilibrium Discrimination
authors: Leonie Baumann, Rohan Dutta
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A group of agents with ex ante independent and identically uncertain quality compete for a prize, awarded by a principal. Agents may possess evidence about the quality of those they share a social connection with (neighbors), and themselves. In one equilibrium, adversarial disclosure of evidence leads the principal to statistically discriminate between agents based on their number of neighbors (degree). We identify parameter values for which an agent’s ex ante winning probability is monotone in degree. All equilibria that satisfy some robustness criteria lie between this adversarial disclosure equilibrium and a less informative one that features no snitching and no discrimination. (JEL D82, D83, D85, Z13)
abstract_zh: 一群事前独立且同分布质量不确定的代理人竞争由委托人授予的奖项。代理人可能掌握其社交关系对象（邻居）及自身质量的证据。在某一均衡中，证据的对抗性披露导致委托人根据代理人拥有的邻居数量（度数）进行统计性歧视。我们识别出使代理人事前获胜概率随度数单调变化的参数区间。所有满足某些稳健性标准的均衡均介于该对抗性披露均衡与一个信息量更少（无告密且无歧视）的均衡之间。（JEL D82, D83, D85, Z13）

title: Young Local Politicians and Deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon
title_zh: 年轻地方政治家与巴西亚马逊地区的森林砍伐
title_primary: 年轻地方政治家与巴西亚马逊地区的森林砍伐
title_secondary: Young Local Politicians and Deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon
authors: Ricardo Dahis, Ivan de las Heras, Santiago Saavedra
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-03-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: While deforestation may yield short-term economic gains, it has lasting impacts on climate change, biodiversity, and water systems. The age of political leaders is a key determinant of how these trade-offs are managed. We study closely contested elections in Brazil and show that when a young politician is in power there is less deforestation (p-value .000), lower greenhouse gas emissions (p-value .061), but higher local income (p-value .023). Results are partly explained by young mayors turning over the bureaucracy with younger public servants (p-value .043).
abstract_zh: 尽管森林砍伐可能带来短期经济收益，但它对气候变化、生物多样性和水系统产生持久影响。政治领导人的年龄是管理这些权衡的关键决定因素。我们研究了巴西竞争激烈的选举，并表明当年轻政治家执政时，森林砍伐减少（p值.000），温室气体排放降低（p值.061），但地方收入提高（p值.023）。结果部分归因于年轻市长通过更年轻的公务员实现官僚机构更替（p值.043）。

title: Detecting Skilled Bond Fund Managers
title_zh: 识别熟练债券基金经理人
title_primary: 识别熟练债券基金经理人
title_secondary: Detecting Skilled Bond Fund Managers
authors: Ron Kaniel, Markus Pelger, Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh, luofeng zhou
official: 官方在线 2026-07-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We employ machine learning methods to identify skill among active bond mutual fund managers. Using a comprehensive dataset of 3,021 unique U.S. bond funds from May 1995 to November 2024, we demonstrate that fund-level and family-level characteristics, particularly past performance metrics, reliably predict future bond fund performance. A prediction-weighted portfolio strategy that goes long the best-10% of funds and short the worst-10% of funds generates monthly abnormal returns of 33 basis points with an information ratio of 27.6%. The outperformance persists for up to 36 months. Holdings-based characteristics do not help to separate good from bad managers. The predictive signal is strongest for corporate and municipal bond funds, while Treasury bond funds exhibit weak performance differentiation. Incorporating equity-side information for corporate bond fund families that also offer equity mutual funds does not enhance predictive performance.
abstract_zh: 我们采用机器学习方法识别主动型债券共同基金经理的选股能力。基于1995年5月至2024年11月期间涵盖3021只美国债券基金的全面数据集，研究表明基金层面与家族层面的特征（尤其是历史业绩指标）能够可靠预测债券基金的未来表现。采用预测加权组合策略（做多表现最佳的前10%基金，做空表现最差的后10%基金），每月可获得33个基点的异常收益，信息比率达27.6%。这种超额收益可持续长达36个月。基于持仓的特征无法有效区分优秀与平庸的基金经理。预测信号在公司和市政债券基金中最为显著，而国债基金的业绩分化较弱。对于同时提供股票型共同基金的企业债券基金家族，纳入股票端信息并未提升预测效果。

title: Rewarding success and failure: moral hazard and adverse selection in strategic experimentation
title_zh: 奖励成功与失败：战略实验中的道德风险与逆向选择
title_primary: 奖励成功与失败：战略实验中的道德风险与逆向选择
title_secondary: Rewarding success and failure: moral hazard and adverse selection in strategic experimentation
authors: Fahad Khalil, Jacques Lawarrée, Alexander Rodivilov
official: 官方在线 2026-06-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A principal hires an agent to learn about the cost of a project (experimentation) and then to execute it (production). The agent is privately informed about the probability that the cost is low, with the high-type agent more optimistic than the low type. Learning is modeled as a series of experiments, where the agent privately chooses his effort in each experiment. Due to the joint presence of adverse selection and moral hazard, even the low type can misrepresent his type, shirk during experimentation and earn a rent. In the optimal contract, the principal uses the length and outcome of experimentation as well as the timing of payments to induce effort and screen the agent. The principal may find it optimal to reward the low type after failure in experimentation. We provide sufficient conditions for both success and failure to be rewarded. We show that over-experimentation can be optimal as it reduces the asymmetric information after a series of failed experiments. We also consider whether it may be optimal to separate experimentation and production between two different agents. When the same agent works on both tasks, the principal can leverage the adverse selection rent to mitigate moral hazard. Therefore, integrating experimentation and production is optimal when adverse selection is severe.
abstract_zh: 委托人雇佣代理人了解项目成本（实验阶段），随后执行项目（生产阶段）。代理人私下知晓成本为低值的概率，其中高类型代理人比低类型代理人更为乐观。学习过程被建模为一系列实验，代理人在每次实验中私下选择其努力程度。由于逆向选择与道德风险同时存在，即使是低类型代理人也可能虚报其类型，在实验期间偷懒并获取租金。在最优合同中，委托人利用实验的时长与结果以及支付的时间安排来激励努力并筛选代理人。委托人可能发现，在实验失败后奖励低类型代理人是最优的。我们为成功与失败均可能获得奖励提供了充分条件。我们证明，过度实验可能成为最优选择，因为它能减少一系列失败实验后的信息不对称。我们还考虑了将实验与生产分配给两个不同代理人是否可能最优。当同一代理人同时承担两项任务时，委托人可以利用逆向选择租金来缓解道德风险。因此，当逆向选择严重时，整合实验与生产是最优的。

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Equitable access to healthcare requires efficient allocation of health infrastructure, yet politics may distort these decisions. This paper studies how politicians distort public hospital allocations in postcolonial Malaysia from 1959 to 2013. Malaysia first allocates hospital funding to districts, then selects specific locations within funded districts for construction. Using six decades of data on hospital construction and elections, I find that constituencies represented by deputy ministers are significantly more likely to receive new hospitals, but only at the location selection stage within districts. District-level funding decisions effectively direct resources to districts far from existing hospitals. I provide suggestive evidence that measurable guidelines for funding decisions exist but not for construction site selection. These results suggest that defining clear guidelines in hospital allocation can limit political distortions.
abstract_zh: 公平获得医疗服务要求卫生基础设施的高效配置，然而政治因素可能扭曲这些决策。本文研究了1959年至2013年间马来西亚后殖民时期政治家如何扭曲公立医院的分配。马来西亚首先将医院资金分配给各地区，然后在获得资金的地区内选择具体建设地点。利用六十年间医院建设和选举的数据，我发现由副部长代表的选区显著更有可能获得新医院，但这仅发生在地区内的选址阶段。地区层面的资金分配决策有效地将资源导向远离现有医院的地区。我提供了暗示性证据表明，资金分配决策存在可衡量的指导方针，但建设选址则不然。这些结果表明，在医院分配中明确清晰的指导方针可以限制政治扭曲。

title: Water Works: Causes and Consequences of Safe Drinking Water in America
title_zh: 水之功效：美国安全饮用水的成因与影响
title_primary: 水之功效：美国安全饮用水的成因与影响
title_secondary: Water Works: Causes and Consequences of Safe Drinking Water in America
authors: David A. Keiser, Bhashkar Mazumder, David Molitor, Joseph S. Shapiro
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Since the 1974 Safe Drinking Water Act, the U.S. has spent $2 trillion to provide safe drinking water, yet drinking water for 10–20 percent of Americans violates standards. We study trends, causes, and consequences of U.S. drinking water pollution, using 266 million readings on 1,250 pollutants over decades that we obtained from 48 states via dozens of Freedom of Information Act and associated requests. We link pollution to administrative Medicare data on older Americans' health outcomes. Three findings emerge. First, U.S. drinking water pollution has declined rapidly; the share of readings exceeding current health standards fell by half from 2003–2019. Unregulated pollutants declined more slowly. Low-income areas have higher pollution; Black and Hispanic communities have more complex patterns. Second, loans provided by the Safe Drinking Water Act to water systems reduce pollution. At the estimated average loan cost-effectiveness, these loans could eliminate pollution above health standards for $46 annually per person. Third, these loans reduce mortality rates of older Americans. Although fiscal federalism cautions against federal funding of local public goods with few inter-jurisdictional externalities like drinking water, we estimate large benefits from Safe Drinking Water Act loans.
abstract_zh: 自1974年《安全饮用水法案》实施以来，美国已投入2万亿美元用于提供安全饮用水，但仍有10%至20%的美国民众的饮用水不符合标准。本研究利用从48个州通过数十次《信息自由法》及相关请求获取的、涵盖数十年间1250种污染物的2.66亿条监测数据，分析了美国饮用水污染的趋势、成因及后果，并将污染数据与老年人医疗保险行政数据中的健康结果进行关联。研究得出三项发现：第一，美国饮用水污染水平快速下降，2003年至2019年间超过现行健康标准的污染物读数比例下降了一半，但未受监管的污染物下降速度较慢。低收入地区污染程度更高，黑人和西班牙裔社区的污染模式更为复杂。第二，《安全饮用水法案》向供水系统提供的贷款有效降低了污染水平。按估算的平均贷款成本效益计算，这些贷款每年仅需人均46美元即可消除超标污染。第三，这些贷款降低了美国老年人的死亡率。尽管财政联邦主义通常反对联邦政府为饮用水这类跨辖区外部性较弱的本地公共品提供资金，但本研究估算显示，《安全饮用水法案》贷款带来了显著的社会效益。

title: The death of the “High Street”? Main street closures, social disorder and urban change
title_zh: 高街”之死？主街关闭、社会失序与城市变迁
title_primary: 高街”之死？主街关闭、社会失序与城市变迁
title_secondary: The death of the “High Street”? Main street closures, social disorder and urban change
authors: Nils Braakmann, Diego Zambiasi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 August 202 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How do changing shopping habits shape cities? We investigate this question in the context of major shop closures. Leveraging geocoded crime and economic data at the level of small areas covering England and Wales, we examine the effects of these closures on criminal activity and urban dynamics. Our findings reveal that closures lead to significant increases in crime. These effects survive a battery of robustness checks and are highly localised. We also find evidence for wider changes to urban areas triggered by the closures. Our results highlight broader implications for declining inner-city areas and the “death of the high street”.
abstract_zh: 不断变化的购物习惯如何塑造城市？我们以大型商店关闭为背景探讨这一问题。利用覆盖英格兰和威尔士的小区域地理编码犯罪与经济数据，我们考察了这些关闭对犯罪活动和城市动态的影响。研究发现，商店关闭导致犯罪显著增加。这些效应在多项稳健性检验中依然存在，且具有高度局部性。我们还发现了关闭引发城市区域更广泛变化的证据。我们的结果凸显了内城区衰退及“高街之死”的更广泛影响。

title: Optimal bailouts in banking and sovereign crises
title_zh: 银行与主权危机中的最优救助
title_primary: 银行与主权危机中的最优救助
title_secondary: Optimal bailouts in banking and sovereign crises
authors: Sewon Hur, César Sosa-Padilla, Zeynep Yom
official: Crossref 元数据日期 August 202 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study optimal bailout policies amidst banking and sovereign crises. Our model features sovereign borrowing with limited commitment, where domestic banks hold government debt and extend credit to the private sector. Bank capital shocks can trigger banking crises, prompting the government to consider extending guarantees over bank assets. This poses a trade-off: Larger bailouts relax financial frictions and increase output, but increase fiscal needs and default risk (creating a ‘diabolic loop’). Optimal bailouts exhibit clear properties. The fraction of banking losses the bailouts cover is (i) decreasing in government debt; (ii) increasing in aggregate productivity; and (iii) increasing in the severity of banking crises. Even though bailouts mitigate the adverse effects of banking crises, the economy is ex ante better off without bailouts: Having access to bailouts lowers the cost of defaults, which in turn increases the default frequency, and reduces the levels of debt, output, and consumption.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了银行危机与主权危机并存时的最优救助政策。模型设定中，主权借款面临有限承诺约束，国内银行持有政府债务并向私营部门发放信贷。银行资本冲击可能引发银行危机，促使政府考虑对银行资产提供担保。这构成了权衡：更大规模的救助虽能缓解金融摩擦并提升产出，但会增加财政需求及违约风险（形成“恶魔循环”）。最优救助政策具有明确特征：救助覆盖银行损失的比例（i）随政府债务增加而下降；（ii）随总生产率提高而上升；（iii）随银行危机严重程度加剧而上升。尽管救助缓解了银行危机的不利影响，但事前而言，无救助的经济状况更优：救助的可获得性降低了违约成本，进而提高了违约频率，并减少了债务、产出和消费水平。

title: Obviously strategy-proof implementation for mixed-ownership object-allocation problems
title_zh: 混合所有制物品分配问题的显然防策略实施
title_primary: 混合所有制物品分配问题的显然防策略实施
title_secondary: Obviously strategy-proof implementation for mixed-ownership object-allocation problems
authors: Changwoo Park
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the problem of allocating indivisible commodities, or “objects”, when some of them are privately owned and some are collectively owned. We search for well-behaved rules that are implementable in “obviously dominant equilibrium”, namely, obviously strategy-proof rules (Li, 2017). We start from the you request my house–I get your turn rules (Abdulkadiroǧlu and Sönmez, 1999), the “AS rules”. We ask whether and when they are obviously strategy-proof. When preferences are strict but otherwise unrestricted, and with at least three agents, the AS rules are obviously strategy-proof if and only if there is at most one owner. This disappointing result raises the question whether things would work out better on some restricted preference domains. On the single-peaked domain, we propose a new family of rules and show that not only are these “priority-augmented crawlers” obviously strategy-proof, but also that they satisfy efficiency, the individual endowments lower bounds, group strategy-proofness, weak neutrality, and separability. On the single-dipped domain, we establish a contrasting result: on this subdomain, unlike on the single-peaked domain, the AS rules are obviously strategy-proof.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在部分商品为私人所有、部分为集体所有的情况下，如何分配不可分割商品或“物品”的问题。我们寻找那些能在“显然占优均衡”中实施的良好行为规则，即显然策略-proof规则（Li, 2017）。我们从“你求我房—我取你轮”规则（Abdulkadiroǧlu和Sönmez, 1999），即“AS规则”出发，探讨它们是否以及何时是显然策略-proof的。当偏好严格但不受其他限制，且至少有三个代理人时，AS规则是显然策略-proof的当且仅当最多只有一个所有者。这一令人失望的结果引发了一个问题：在某些受限偏好域上，情况是否会更好。在单峰偏好域上，我们提出了一族新规则，并证明这些“优先级增强爬行规则”不仅是显然策略-proof的，而且满足效率、个人禀赋下限、群体策略-proof性、弱中立性和可分离性。在单谷偏好域上，我们得出了一个对比性结果：在此子域上，与单峰偏好域不同，AS规则是显然策略-proof的。

title: Dual peer effects and cross-stock predictability
title_zh: 双重同伴效应与跨股票可预测性

authors: Doron Avramov, Shuyi Ge, Shaoran Li, Oliver Linton
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper introduces a Peer Index (PI) constructed from economically motivated peer networks that summarizes (i) the strength of a firm’s peers and (ii) the firm’s position within its peer group. PI predicts stock returns and earnings surprises over short and long horizons. Machine-learning models based solely on firm-level characteristics do not subsume PI’s predictive power, supporting the interpretation that it captures genuine cross-stock information. Lag-augmented local projections show that positive PI innovations are followed by higher next-month returns that gradually decay without reversal, consistent with slow diffusion of peer information into prices.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个基于经济动机驱动的同行网络“同行指数”（Peer Index, PI），该指数综合反映了（i）企业同行的实力强度及（ii）企业在同行群体中的地位。PI能够预测股票回报及盈利惊喜，在短期和长期时间跨度内均有效。仅基于企业层面特征的机器学习模型无法涵盖PI的预测能力，这支持了其捕捉真实跨股票信息的解释。通过滞后增强的局部投影分析显示，正向的PI创新会带来下月回报的提升，随后逐渐衰减且无逆转现象，这与同行信息缓慢融入价格的过程相一致。

title: Antecedents of firm responses to innovation deregulation: evidence from the incrementally modified drug policy in Korea
title_zh: 企业应对创新放松管制的先决条件：来自韩国渐进式药品政策改革的证据
title_primary: 企业应对创新放松管制的先决条件：来自韩国渐进式药品政策改革的证据
title_secondary: Antecedents of firm responses to innovation deregulation: evidence from the incrementally modified drug policy in Korea
authors: Hee Jin Mun, Yerim Chung
official: 官方在线 2025-09-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The removal of institutional restrictions on innovation can foster industrial growth, but the success of deregulation remains uncertain due to differences in firms’ motivation and capabilities to exploit the opportunities it creates. In the context of the 2008 deregulation of incrementally modified drugs (IMDs) in Korea, we argue that firms’ motivation to develop IMDs depends on their performance relative to aspiration levels, and that their capabilities – specifically, the specialization and scope of knowledge assets – jointly facilitate the launch of IMDs. An empirical analysis of Korean pharmaceutical firms from 2008 to 2017 revealed that firms were more likely to introduce IMDs when their performance was near aspiration levels or when they possessed both diverse and specialized knowledge assets. This study enhances our understanding of the internal factors shaping variations in firms’ responses to innovation deregulation and offers insights for policymakers seeking to promote innovation.
abstract_zh: 取消对创新的制度性限制可以促进产业增长，但由于企业利用由此创造机会的动机和能力存在差异，放松管制的成效仍不确定。以2008年韩国渐进改良药物（IMDs）放松管制为背景，我们认为企业开发IMDs的动机取决于其绩效与期望水平的差距，而其能力——特别是知识资产的专精程度与范围——共同推动了IMDs的上市。对2008年至2017年韩国制药企业的实证分析表明，当企业绩效接近期望水平，或同时拥有多样化与专精化知识资产时，其推出IMDs的可能性更高。本研究深化了对企业应对创新放松管制差异的内在因素的理解，并为旨在促进创新的政策制定者提供了启示。
